title: CT 18: Quantitative Aptitude (Speed, Time and Distance)

questions.text: Rashmi started a journey of 480 km by car. She wants to complete the journey as soon as possible for that she wants to maintain the speed of the car at 80 kmph. She maintains the speed for 62.5% of distance and after that, she took a break for 30 mins. and then starts the journey with 60 kmph. What is the difference between the actual time taken and the planned time for the entire journey?
questions.explanation:
GIVEN :

Total journey distance = 480 km

Ideal average speed = 80 kmph

Planned or time taken in ideal condition = 480/80 = 6 hour = 360 minutes

 

CALCULATION :

For actual time,

Distance in which average speed of 80 kmph is maintained.

Distance covered before break = 62.5% of 480 = (5/8) × 480 = 300 km

Time taken to cover this distance = 300/80 = 3.75 hour = 225 minutes

After the break,

Distance need to be covered = 480 - 300 = 180 km

Time required to cover the distance = 180/60 = 3 hour = 180 minutes

Actual time of journey = 225 + 180 + 30 = 435 minutes

∴ Difference in time = 435 - 360 = 75 min

questions.text: A vehicle started from point A with the initial speed of 42 km/h with its speed increasing every hour by 6 km/h. If the distance between point A and B is 420 km, what is the time taken by the vehicle to complete the distance?
questions.explanation:
Given:

Initial speed of vehicle = 42 km/h

Increment of speed every hour = 6 km/h

Distance between the points A and B = 420 km

Formula used:

Sn = (n/2){2a + (n – 1)d}

Sn = Sum of terms in arithmetic progression

n = Number of terms

a = First term

d = Difference

Calculation:

Sn = 420

a = 42

d = 6

420 = (n/2){2 × 42 + (n – 1) × 6

⇒ 840 = n{84 + 6n – 6}

⇒ 840 = n{78 + 6n}

⇒ 840 = 78n + 6(n)2

⇒ 6n2 + 78n – 840 = 0

⇒ n2 + 13n – 140 = 0

By factorizing we get,

⇒ n = 7

∴ The time taken by the vehicle to complete the distance is 7 h.

questions.text: Car A travels from point P to Q with the speed of 40 kmph and return with the speed of x kmph If, the average  speed of the whole journey is 720/17 kmph. Find the total distance covered by the car if the car travels at the 80% of the returning speed for 4 hours.
questions.explanation:
Solution:

Speed of car while moving P to Q = 40 kmph

Speed of car while moving Q to P = x kmph

Average speed of whole journey = (720/17) kmph

Average speed = 2×  A ×  B/(A + B)

720/17 = 2 ×  (40 ×  x)/(40 + x)

720/17 × (40 + x) = 80x

(28800 + 720x) = 1360x

640x = 28800

x = 45 kmph

80 % of the Speed of the car while returning = 45 × 80/100 = 36 kmph

Total distance covered = 36 × 4 = 144 km

questions.text: A persons drives his motorcycle at 55 km/hr for 4 hours and at a speed of 60 km/hr for next 5 hours. After that he finds that he covered only 4/5<sup style="">th</sup> of the total distance. Then, find the speed (in km/hour) of the motorcycle if he want to cover the remaining distance in 2.5 hours?
questions.explanation:
Given:

55 km/hr for 4 hrs + 60 km/hour for 5 hours = 4/5 of the total distance

Formula used:

Distance = Speed × Time

Calculation:

Distance covered in 4 hours = 55 × 4 = 220 km

Distance covered in next 5 hours = 60 × 5 = 300 km

Suppose the total distance is x km.

Now, he finds that he has covered 4/5th of the total distance.

According to question –

⇒ 4/5 × x = (220 + 300)

⇒ 4/5 × x = 520

⇒ x = 520 × 5/4

⇒ x = 650 km

∴ Remaining distance = 650 – (220 + 300) = 650 – 520 = 130 km

We know that, Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ required speed = 130/2.5

⇒ 52 km/hour

 

Let the total distance be = 50 unit km

⇒ 4/5 of 50 unit = 40 unit km. travelled

According to question:

⇒ 40 unit km = 520 km

⇒ Left distance = 10 unit km = 520/40 × 10 = 130 km

⇒ Required speed = 130/2.5 = 52 km/hour

questions.text: Four cities A, B, C and D are at the corner of a rectangle and distance between A and B is twice the distance between B and C. A person travels from A to B at 10 km/h, B to C at 20 km/h, C to D at 30 km/h and D to A at 40 km/h. Find the average speed of the whole journey.
questions.explanation:
Let the distance between A and B is 2x km

⇒ Distance between B and C = 2x/2 = x km

As four cities are at the corner of a rectangle,

⇒ Distance between C and D = 2x km

⇒ Distance between D and A = x km

Now,

⇒ Time taken to cover distance from A to B = 2x/10 = (x/5) h

⇒ Time taken to cover distance from B to C = (x/20) h

⇒ Time taken to cover distance from C to D = 2x/30 = (x/15) h

⇒ Time taken to cover distance from D to A = (x/40) h

⇒ Total time taken by the person for the whole journey

⇒ (x/5) + (x/20) + (x/15) + (x/40) = (41x/120) h

⇒ Total distance of the whole journey = 2x + x + 2x + x = 6x km

∴ Average speed of whole journey = total distance/total time = 6x/(41x/120) = 720/41 km/h

Alternative Solution,

Here we can let the distance between A to B be 100 km, now as the distance between B to C is half of the distance between A to B, so the distance between B to C will be 50. Same, the distance between C to D will 100km and A to D be 50km.

⇒ Total Time = 100/10 + 50/20 + 100/30 + 50/40 = 17.08

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance/Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = (100 + 50 + 100 + 50)/17.08

⇒ Average Speed = 300/17.08

∴ Average Speed = 720/41

questions.text: Ramakant goes from home to bus stand at the speed 14 km/h, and he reaches 6 minutes late. Next day he goes at the speed of 35 km/h, and he reaches 42 minutes early. Find the distance between her house and bus stand.
questions.explanation:
Given:

When speed is 14 kmph reaches 6 min late

When speed is 35 kmph reaches 42 min early

Formula:

Speed = distance/time

Calculation:

Let the distance be 'x' km

Therefore time taken to cover 'x' km at 14 kmph = x/14​ hr

Time taken to cover 'x'km at 35 kmph = x/35​ hr

But it is given that the difference between two timings 

⇒ 42 + 6 = 48 min = 48/60​ hr = 4/5

⇒ x/14 ​– x/35 ​= 4/5

⇒ (35x − 14x)​/(35 × 14) = 4/5

⇒ 21x/​(35 × 14) = 4/5

⇒ x = 56/3 km 

∴ Distance between home and bus stand is (56/3) km.

questions.text: Noody travels 480 km to his home, partly by train and party by car. He takes 12 hours if he travels 280 km by train and the rest by car. He takes 24 minutes more of he travels 40 km by train and the rest by car. The speeds of the train and the car respectively are
questions.explanation:
Noody travels 480km to his home by car and train.

Let the speed of car be “SC” km/h

And that of train be “ST” km/h

We know that, distance = speed × time

⇒ time = distance / speed ……………….Formula 1

In the first instance, he takes 12 hours to travel to his home when he travels 280 km by train

∴ He travels 200km by car.

∵ Total time taken is 12 hours,

\(\frac{{200}}{{{S_C}}} + \frac{{280}}{{{S_T}}} = 12\)  [From formula 1]

⇒ 200ST + 280SC = 12(ST)(SC) …………….Equation 1

In the second instance, he takes 24 minutes more i.e., 12.4 hours to travel to his home when he travels 40 km by train

∴ He travels 440km by car.

∵ Total time taken is 12.4 hours,

\(\frac{{440}}{{{S_C}}} + \frac{{40}}{{{S_T}}} = 12.4\) [From formula 1]

⇒ 440 ST + 40 SC = 12.4(ST)(SC) …………….Equation 2

Solving the Equations 1,2 simultaneously we get ,

SC = 38.506 km/h

ST = 41.135 km/h

∴ Speeds of train and car respectively are 41.135 km/h and 38.506 km/h.

questions.text: Kishor after travelling 80 km decreases his speed. He then proceeds at 2/3<sup>rd</sup> of his former speed and arrives at his destination 60 minutes late. Had he decreased his speed 30 km further, Kishor would have reached the destination 40 minutes late. What is the initial speed of Kishor?
questions.explanation:
GIVEN :

Let the initial speed of Kishor = x km/hr

⇒ Decreased speed = 2x/3 km/hr.

If he decreased his speed 30 km further that means speed of Kishor in that 30 km would have been x km/hr instead of 2x/3 km/hr and that would have made difference of 20 minutes (60 – 40) in time taken.

 

CALCULATION :

⇒ 30/ (2x/3) - 30/x = 20/60

⇒ 15/x = 1/3

⇒ x = 45 km/hr

∴ Initial speed of Kishor = 45 km/hr

questions.text: Two cities A and B are 200 km apart, Two trains Starts from each station toward each other. They started their journey at the same time from A and B respectively. They meet after 8 hours, if the speed of one train that is coming from A to B is 8 km faster than the speed of another train find the speed of the faster train?
questions.explanation:
Given that Total distance = 200 km

Speed of slower train = x km/h

Speed of faster train = (x + 8) km/h

relative speed = x + x + 8 = (2x + 8) km/h

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ 2x + 8 = 200/8 = 25

⇒ x = 17/2 

⇒ x = 8.5 km/h

∴ Speed of faster train = 8.5 + 8 = 16.5 km/hr

questions.text: A bus covers half of its journey at a certain speed. In the remaining half-part of the journey, the speed of the bus increased by 50%. The average speed of the bus in the whole journey is what percentage of the speed of the bus in the remaining half-part of the journey?
questions.explanation:
GIVEN :

Let the speed of the bus in the first half of the journey be ‘x’ km/hr.

In the remaining half-part, speed of bus increased by 50%,

 

CALCULATION :

⇒ Speed of bus in remaining half-part of journey = (100 + 50)% of x = 150% of x = 1.5x

Now, if a body travels at two different speeds of ‘a’ km/hr. and ‘b’ km/hr., then the average speed is given as 2ab/(a + b),

Hence,

Average speed of bus in whole journey = (2 × x × 1.5x)/(x + 1.5x) = 1.2x

∴ Required percentage = (1.2x/1.5x) × 100 = 80%
